summary_zh: 泰國9月汽車產量受洪水衝擊年減6.08%，天災停工首度成為新痛點，產能與交期管理受考驗；國內銷售年增14.28%，主要來自電動車。工業部將自11月2日起稽查1,500家廢棄物工廠，環保合規壓力持續升高。東部經濟走廊委員會另批准4個新投資區，總額256.6億泰銖。
summary_en: Floods cut Thai September auto output 6.08% YoY, making disaster-driven stoppages a new pain for capacity and delivery planning. From Nov 2 the Industry Ministry will inspect 1,500 waste factories, raising compliance pressure. The EEC approved 4 new investment zones worth THB 25.66bn.

items.summary_zh: 泰國乙醇業協會歡迎內閣調降E20汽油醇與B20生質柴油的消費稅。
items.summary_en: The Thai Ethanol Manufacturing Association welcomes the cabinet's cut in excise taxes on E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel.

items.title: ส.อ.ท. เผยน้ำท่วมกระเทือนยอดผลิตรถเดือน ก.ย. ฮวบ 6.08%

items.summary_en: Thailand's September car production fell 6.08% year on year as floods hit output, while domestic sales rose 14.28%, mainly on EVs.
